purpose: Owner-scoped execution control over existing packet DAGs; not a second queue or evidence of completion
scope_precedence: Latest owner direction: V2.3 is the minimum desired SwarmAI milestone and V2.7 is the target. Existing canonical V2.3 plan is active subject to dependencies/reviews. V2.7 has no accepted contract yet; V27_OWNER_REVIEW_PROPOSAL_20260922.md is proposal-only.
stop_after: Reach accepted V2.3 minimum; V2.7 implementation requires owner/lead acceptance of a V2.7 contract/packet DAG.
rules: V2.3 is the current minimum owner goal and may advance only through the existing cemented dependency/review plan; do not skip unfinished predecessor acceptance gates.
V2.7 is a requested target only. No V2.7 implementation authority exists until its proposed definition and packet DAG are explicitly accepted.
Current owner hold forbids new live/model/provider/scheduler/spend/main-merge actions; earlier broad private-$0 live permission is superseded for new runs.
Use methodical root-cause debugging: reproduce, map cause, repair narrowly, preserve detailed source-bound notes and adverse tests.
Live means a running private/local candidate plus relevant real operational tests; a health endpoint or a local fixture alone is insufficient.
Existing review holds remain mandatory; worker may prepare review bundles but may not invent reviews.
A ready label never overrides dependencies or execution prerequisites.
Evidence-only or review-pending can explain a historical code baseline, but cannot satisfy a live checkpoint.
Existing GitHub account use is authorized for R33c only after a fresh read-only host probe and exact action approvals; tool connectivity elsewhere is not local gh authentication.
Structural validate_plan.py output is not permission to execute. Apply execution_guard.py and packet/runtime checks.
Empty reviewed_packets and frozen_packets do not preapprove future code or unresolved acceptance thresholds.
Do not replace the registry, duplicate queues, or rewrite historical evidence. Scope controls authorization, not artifact acceptance.
A heartbeat tick is not progress; preserve last real activity time and inspect the actual worker or long-running test process.
phase_policy: V1.7 remains the current executable phase. After its required handoff/review, the lead may release only V1.8/V1.9/V2.0 packets from the existing future queue; V2.3/V3 remain forbidden.
method: Reproduce actual failure first where possible, record root-cause/causal map and detailed source-bound notes, then make the smallest bounded repair and test adverse paths.
